751-1115-3286.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

225-2645-3430-3478.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

950-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Fatestitcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
950-3469-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

2577-2921-5478-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-2921-5478-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-2921-5478-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1981-2415-6797-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6797-7173.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1170-7522-7875.description:
Cast Stream of Life using the convoke ability from Party Thrasher by tapping Infirmary Healer.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Infirmary Healer, which enters prepared.
Resolve Stream of Life.
Repeat.

1263-1417-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4289-4478-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-4478-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-4478-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1061-3557-7679.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
An opponent cannot block Brago.
1061-3557-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Brago.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

4823-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Timeless Witness and exiling Ephemerate.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3705-4050-6896-7316.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

2034-6026-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-6026-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Field of Souls and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

369-2730-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

483-3967-5170-6132.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1753-2366-3322-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1753-2366-3322-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-3534-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3534-5226.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
250-779-1479-3534-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4222-4474-6936.description:
Activate Goblin Medics by tapping it, adding {U}.
Goblin Medics triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

1170-5089-6855.manaNeeded: {3} plus {X} each turn, where X is 14 minus the greatest power among creatures you control
1170-5089-6855.description:
Cast The Dominion Bracelet by paying {2}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Karn.
Activate The Dominion Bracelet's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature you control with the greatest power.
Activate the creature by paying at most {14} and exiling The Dominion Bracelet, causing you to control an opponent during their next turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters on it, putting The Dominion Bracelet from exile into your hand.
Repeat during each of your turns.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-5362-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
2743-5362-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Quantum Misalignment twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Quantum Misalignments, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

500-1270-2523-4772.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ojer Taq and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Ojer Taq token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Ojer Taqs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2*(3^X) nonlegendary token copies of Ojer Taq that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Ojer Taqs you control.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-1270-2523-4772.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^695.6224481408007) creature tokens.

141-5147-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-4871-5913-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4050-4871-5913-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Pinnacle Monk and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Pinnacle Monk, adding {4}
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

914-1322-3335.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1322-3335.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-1322-3335.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

710-2386-2579-4050.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Danitha.
710-2386-2579-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Danitha on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Danitha from your library onto the battlefield.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

204-776-3716.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least six creatures without summoning sickness.
204-776-3716.description:
Activate six creatures you control by tapping them, adding {4}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Fanning the Flames to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Fanning the Flames to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control seven or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

38-2506-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Fable of the Mirror-Breaker has exactly two lore counters on it.
"Goblin" or "Shaman" chosen with Molten Echoes.
38-2506-3337.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker triggers, causing you to put a lore counter on it.
Fable of the Mirror-Breaker's third chapter ability triggers, exiling it, and returning it to the battlefield as Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
When Reflection of Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Activate the token Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the nontoken Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the tapped Reflection of Kiki-Jiki token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 4.

1349-2793-4050-4241-4742.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability and Nahiri's Resolve trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding one mana of any color.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Nahiri's Resolve trigger from step 2, exiling Ugin's Nexus until your next upkeep.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Nahiri's Resolve triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-824-4289.notablePrerequisites: Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
129-824-4289.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from target creature onto another creature.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may choose to add other colors of mana, and use the mana to activate Kinnan's ability.
